rules.rule_name: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Name & Complete Address
rules.requirement: Every package shall bear the name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer.
rules.conditions: Must include business name, street/area/locality, city, state, and pin code.
rules.exemptions: Net weight <= 10g/10ml, or hotel/restaurant fast food items packed on demand.

rules.rule_name: Generic or Common Name of Commodity
rules.requirement: The package shall clearly declare the common or generic name of the commodity contained therein.
rules.conditions: Generic descriptive name must be legible on the principal display panel.

rules.rule_name: Net Quantity in Standard Metric Units
rules.requirement: The package shall state net quantity in terms of standard metric units (g, kg, ml, l, m, count). Non-metric units (lbs, oz) shall not be used alone.
rules.conditions: Must declare numerical value followed by standard metric symbol.
rules.exemptions: Bulk packages > 50kg or packages < 10g/10ml sold unpackaged.

rules.rule_name: Month & Year of Manufacture / Packing / Import
rules.requirement: Every package shall mention month and year of manufacture, packing or import. Limited shelf-life items must state Best Before or Expiry date.
rules.conditions: Format MM/YYYY or Month YYYY or Use By / Best Before DD/MM/YYYY.

rules.rule_name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) Inclusive of All Taxes
rules.requirement: Maximum Retail Price must be declared in INR (Rs. or ₹) with explicit words 'inclusive of all taxes' or 'incl. of all taxes'.
rules.conditions: Must be prominently displayed. Retailer cannot charge above this MRP.

rules.requirement: Package must state the name, address, telephone number, and e-mail of consumer care cell.
rules.conditions: Customer care helpline and email must be clearly readable.

rules.requirement: Every package of imported commodity must declare country of origin or manufacture.
rules.conditions: Mandatory for imported items; verified via manufacturer address for domestic goods.
rules.exemptions: Domestic Indian products where manufacturer location is explicitly stated.

rules.requirement: Packages > 1kg/1L must declare Unit Sale Price in Rs./kg or Rs./L; packages < 1kg/1L in Rs./100g or Rs./100ml.
rules.conditions: Unit sale price must be displayed alongside MRP.
rules.exemptions: Packages where net quantity equals 1 unit.

rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(d) proviso read with FSSAI Regulations
rules.requirement: Pre-packaged food must display Best Before / Expiry date and FSSAI License Number.
rules.conditions: Applicable strictly to food products and beverages.
